findings.failure_mode: Software-WebGL confound: Chrome is launched with --disable-gpu, so every runtime number is measured under SwiftShader software rasterization without the report recording or disclosing the renderer (opus#1, sol#1).
The runtime profile is n=1, not the median-of-N the task's own declared strategy requires (opus#2, sol#2, terra#1).
Pan/zoom is driven by mouse/wheel events, a different MapLibre handler than a real phone's touch gestures (opus#5, sol#2).
The 865 ms amenities p95 is attributed wholly to PostGIS although the endpoint first makes a cold ORS isochrone call (~180 ms) (opus#4).
run-all reports stale result files when a sub-runner fails instead of deleting old results and exiting non-zero (opus#3, sol#4, terra#3).
api-latency.json's note says 'warm p95' while the verdict uses the cold p95 (sonnet#1, opus).
findings.fix_evidence: not load-tested. Re-running the harness without flushing

findings.failure_mode: Cold suggest/geocode use fixed keys while ApiCache persists, so re-runs silently measure warm hits unless the cache is flushed (sol#3, terra#2).
findings.fix_evidence: flush first:  docker exec howfar-postgis psql

findings.failure_mode: The mode-toggle and canvas-point steps silently continue when the toggle did not flip or no canvas point resolved, so a bogus interaction can be reported (terra#4).
The proposed next/dynamic 143 KB saving is asserted, but a dynamic import that renders immediately stays 'initial' under networkidle0; the win needs a real deferral boundary and a re-measure (sol#5).
findings.fix_evidence: not just a `next/dynamic` that renders immediately

findings.failure_mode: The frame filter drops intervals ≥1000 ms, discarding exactly the real stalls the worst-frame budget targets (opus note).
